finished_system_target: VARIABLE COGNITIVE GRID + PERSISTENT DATABASE + CLAUDE CODE

problem.current_training_risk: Semantic Hyperposition and Global J-Space can be accidentally specified as if there were one privileged raw hidden-state coordinate system whose numerical equality to an external J-Space state is the supervised target.
why_this_is_unsafe_scientifically: Behaviorally effective activation interventions can belong to large non-identifiable equivalence classes; behavioral control does not uniquely recover one steering vector.
A model may first learn shallow binding heuristics before a systematic routing mechanism, so aggregate opaque-label accuracy can hide the wrong internal mechanism.
Strong control can move representations away from the model's valid-generation manifold, so target-direction preference and retained task utility must be measured separately.
Claude Code does not currently expose a proven activation-level interface; therefore Global-J-Space training must not invent Claude internal activation coordinates as labels.

external_primary_method_inputs.title: On the Identifiability of Steering Vectors in Large Language Models
external_primary_method_inputs.method_input: Steering vectors are generally non-identifiable from input-output behavior alone; identifiability can improve under additional assumptions such as statistical independence, sparsity, multi-environment validation, or cross-layer consistency.
external_primary_method_inputs.clay_interpretation: Do not define semantic Hyperposition or J-Space by literal equality to one raw activation vector. Treat model-coordinate realization as an equivalence-class identification problem constrained by causal and cross-environment tests.

external_primary_method_inputs.title: Why Steering Works: Toward a Unified View of Language Model Parameter Dynamics
external_primary_method_inputs.method_input: Control interventions exhibit a preference-utility tradeoff and can be interpreted relative to an activation manifold; stronger target control can degrade coherent/task-valid generation when representations are pushed off-manifold.
external_primary_method_inputs.clay_interpretation: J-Space control acceptance must pair intended semantic/control effect with utility/retention/off-target measures, not optimize target-axis movement alone.

external_primary_method_inputs.title: How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
external_primary_method_inputs.method_input: Training can pass through a shallow-heuristic phase before systematic variable dereferencing; causal interventions are used to distinguish mechanism and reveal routing through residual-stream state.
external_primary_method_inputs.clay_interpretation: Trigger-2 binder evaluation must inspect checkpoint trajectories and mechanism-sensitive/OOD tests so shallow codebook shortcuts are not mistaken for the intended episode-local binder.

external_primary_method_inputs.title: Larger language models do in-context learning differently
external_primary_method_inputs.method_input: Models differ in their ability to override pretrained semantic priors and learn flipped or semantically unrelated input-label mappings in context; this ability is scale-sensitive.
external_primary_method_inputs.clay_interpretation: Opaque counterbalanced codebooks remain necessary to force episode-local binding; a failure on a small model is diagnostic but cannot by itself identify the failure as representation absence.

core_training_correction.semantic_state_definition: Semantic Hyperposition is the carrier-independent typed branch/state ontology already required by the cross-cutting contract.
core_training_correction.model_coordinate_definition: A concrete model's activation realization is a model/checkpoint/layer/site-specific carrier that may be a vector, low-rank subspace, distributed basis, or nonlinear/manifold-local representation.
core_training_correction.jspace_control_abi_definition: A J-Space control ABI should specify semantic state variables, admissible transformations, observable read/write behavior, causal intervention semantics, provenance and validation gates; it should not require raw coordinate equality unless exact model-specific evidence identifies that coordinate convention.
core_training_correction.equivalence_law: Two internal carriers may count as functionally equivalent only when a preregistered mapping preserves the required semantic relations and causal control behavior on held-out environments while passing nuisance/off-target/retention controls.
core_training_correction.no_raw_coordinate_label_law: Do not generate positive SFT labels that assert an exact hidden activation vector/subspace for Qwen3.5-0.8B or Claude Code unless those coordinates come from exact model-specific executable evidence with frozen source/checkpoint/tokenizer/layer/site identity.
core_training_correction.claude_boundary: If Claude Code exposes only text/tool/session surfaces, train the bridge against typed ClayCode/shared-state/Hyperposition packets and causal re-entry outcomes at that observable interface; activation-level Global-J-Space coupling remains HYPOTHESIS_ONLY.

Positive coordinate/control labels require exact checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/layer/site plus intervention and held-out causal evidence. Qwen3-0.6B carrier directions are not positive coordinate labels for Qwen3.5-0.8B by ancestry.
Train typed semantic state transfer, compression, handoff/return reconciliation and causal re-entry receipts. Do not claim or supervise inaccessible Claude internal activation coordinates.

causal_acceptance: held-out intervention changes intended semantic/process behavior
lesion or removal degrades the targeted function
rescue restores the intended function when a lesion design supports rescue
off-target tasks remain within preregistered tolerance
general language/code and required cognitive capability retention remain within frozen floors
multi-environment validation prevents one prompt/template/codebook environment from defining the carrier
cross-layer consistency may be diagnostic but cannot substitute for behavioral causal evidence

geometry_hypothesis_ladder.rule: Use the simplest preregistered carrier family that passes held-out causal acceptance; failure of a simpler family routes to the next hypothesis and does not prove semantic absence.
geometry_hypothesis_ladder.anti_overfit: A fresh geometry successor must be preregistered before opening a fresh holdout; do not tune a successor on a falsified/frozen holdout.
